target_policy: Development labels only; no holdout scoring. Full train labels used only for final fit.
context_policy: Transductive unlabeled full train+test roster: group size, peer attributes, unanimous imputation. No target propagation.
gate: Screen accuracy >0.83 and improvement >=0.001; both new split seeds improve; confirmation mean accuracy >0.83 and mean gain >=0.001. Candidate frozen before confirmation. User approval required before online submission.
tabm_policy: Compact13 plus seven original numeric missing flags; all medians/scaling/category vocabularies/constant filtering/quantile bins fit inside the applicable training split. Inner stratified20% selects epoch by logloss; a fresh full-outer-training preprocessing/model refit uses exactly that many epochs. Separate BCE loss per member; mean sigmoid probabilities at inference. No outer-validation labels for epoch selection, no pretrained weights or cloud inference.
